comment: Models only the Windows app downloads, in the same shape as module-one/models/artifact-pins.json (ModelManifest reads both). Entries here are STAGED, not published: the repository is a placeholder and the revision is 40 zeros until the files are uploaded; ModelDownloader refuses a staged entry. When the user uploads the GGUF files, replace repository and revision with the real values, drop "staged", and move the entry into artifact-pins.json if the Mac should see it too.
